methodology: Frozen source commit compared with fixed baseline; canonical repository-relative paths. Disk hashes rechecked separately. New untracked next-cycle reproduction files are listed outside this frozen cycle.
SHA256 values cover exact inspected disk/git-blob bytes, including CRLF/LF differences. No source blobs or environment values included.

Top-level exported function declarations and arrow/function-valued exports parsed with installed TypeScript. Other exported symbols are labeled. Nested/object/class methods are not additional exported-function records.

Environment references are names only from static process.env access, test vi.stubEnv calls, and .env.example assignments. Baseline reference paths use literal-name source search, which can include comments.
Existing master id/key/source fields copied without changes for mapping only. No permanent IDs or audit statuses assigned.
Generated finalaudit.md and docs/final-audit artifacts are excluded; localization/tests/configuration are not counted as product features.
Source checkpoint is frozen; any later edits require hash verification. Complete committed changed-path set and every corresponding working-file hash are checked after generation.

freezeVerification.scope: Exact local source/test/config bytes and commit relation only; no workflow, live provider or deployed-policy claims.
